role: The interface ItemDye's bone meal consults: can the block still grow here, should this use be consumed, and grow from this use.

members.name: func_149851_a
members.note: the can-grow gate; the isRemote argument is always false server-side and is ignored

members.name: func_149853_b
members.note: the growth body; itemuse.c's bonemeal is the ItemDye.onItemUse caller

notes: Implemented by BlockCrops, BlockStem, BlockGrass, BlockSapling, BlockMushroom and BlockTallGrass, each of which carries its own record; the interface's three calls are the dispatch points in randomtick.c.
